notes.title: November 2022 Patch
notes.content:
The latest patch had an error that broke some Steam Features (Overlay, Achievements).
This one fixes that regression!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: October 2022 Patch
notes.content:
Hello!
This patch fixes 2 bugs that were occurring when playing the game on high refresh rate monitors.

[list]
[*] Sliding speed was extremely slow.
[*] Jack's spinning animation speed when entering or exiting a level was not working as intended.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
